ma.pageScrollTo(Object object)

Scroll the page to the target position. Scrolling distance positioning is supported.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
scrollTop Number 0 No Scrolls to the target position on the page. The unit is pixel.
duration Number 300 No The duration of the scrolling animation, in ms. If set to 0, it will automatically take 300.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call success or failed.)

Sample Code

ma.pageScrollTo({
  scrollTop: 0,
  duration: 300,
  success: function(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail: function(err) {
    console.log(err);
  }
})
